title: Beyond the Final Embedding: Retrieving Memories from Token-Level Evidence
abstract: arXiv:2610.13277v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Memory-augmented assistants retrieve evidence from stored conversations and documents to answer queries. Most embedding-based retrievers compare single-vector representations of queries and memories, even when relevance depends on a small part of the content. Such local evidence can be matched to queries using the contextual token representations already computed by the same embedding models. Our method uses sparse token matching to improve retrieval without additional training. Each query token retrieves a small set of matching tokens across candidate memories. The matching scores are aggregated for each memory and combined with whole-memory similarity to rank memories. An optional low-rank query adapter can be trained with supervision while keeping the encoder and stored memory representations fixed. Our method improves retrieval across eight benchmarks and multiple model families without additional training. Query adaptation further

translated_title: 超越最终嵌入：从词元级证据中检索记忆
translated_abstract: 记忆增强型助手从存储的对话和文档中检索证据以回答查询。大多数基于嵌入的检索器比较查询和记忆的单向量表示，即使相关性往往只取决于内容的一小部分。这种局部证据可以利用同一嵌入模型已经计算出的上下文词元表示与查询进行匹配。我们的方法使用稀疏词元匹配来改进检索，且无需额外训练。每个查询词元在候选记忆中检索一小撮匹配的词元，匹配得分针对每条记忆进行聚合，并与整条记忆的相似度相结合来对记忆进行排序。可选的低秩查询适配器可以在监督下进行训练，同时保持编码器和已存储的记忆表示固定。我们的方法无需额外训练即可在八个基准测试和多个模型家族上提升检索性能。查询适配器可进一步……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种无需额外训练的稀疏词元匹配方法，利用嵌入模型已有的词元级上下文表示捕捉局部证据，并结合整条记忆相似度对记忆排序，在八个基准测试和多个模型家族上显著提升检索效果，还可通过可选的低秩查询适配器进一步增强。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a training-free sparse token matching method that leverages token-level contextual representations from existing embedding models to capture local evidence, aggregating token-level scores with whole-memory similarity to improve retrieval across eight benchmarks and multiple model families, with an optional low-rank query adapter for further gains.
